node.label: xanthomatosis
node.definition: A condition marked by the development of widespread xanthomas, yellow tumor-like structures filled with lipid deposits. Xanthomas can be found in a variety of tissues including the skin; tendons; joints of knees and elbows. Xanthomatosis is associated with disturbance of lipid metabolism and formation of foam cells.

mechanism_classes.label: lysosomal storage (degradation inside the lysosome fails)
